instagram.caption:
How to remember the tasks that pop into your head at the worst time (ADHD) 🎙️

My brain hands me tasks everywhere except at my desk:

1. In the shower: book the dentist
2. In line at the supermarket: pay the electricity bill
3. On a walk with the stroller: email my boss
4. 11pm, kids finally asleep: sign the school form

Now I just say it out loud, wherever I am. FOCO turns it into a task and it all waits in my day. Nothing left to hold in my head.

📌 Save this for the next shower thought, and send it to someone whose best ideas come at the worst time.
💜 Try FOCO, link in bio.
